description: Source code for credential management in a Git-related project, including functions for credential initialization, clearing, matching, URL parsing, configuration, and interaction with credential helpers.

methods.name: credential_init
methods.description: Initializes a credential struct to default values.

methods.name: credential_clear
methods.description: Clears sensitive data and resets a credential struct.

methods.name: credential_next_state
methods.description: Prepares credential struct for next state, swapping headers.

methods.name: credential_clear_secrets
methods.description: Clears secret fields like password and credential.

methods.name: credential_set_capability
methods.description: Sets specific capability flags based on operation type.

methods.name: credential_set_all_capabilities
methods.description: Enables all capabilities for a credential.

methods.name: announce_one
methods.description: Announces a single capability if requested.

methods.name: credential_announce_capabilities
methods.description: Outputs supported capabilities and version.

methods.name: credential_match
methods.description: Checks if two credentials match based on specified fields.

methods.name: credential_config_callback
methods.description: Handles configuration variables for credentials.

methods.name: proto_is_http
methods.description: Checks if protocol is HTTP or HTTPS.

methods.name: credential_describe
methods.description: Creates a human-readable description of a credential.

methods.name: credential_format
methods.description: Formats a credential into a URL-like string.

methods.name: credential_ask_one
methods.description: Prompts user for a credential component.

methods.name: credential_getpass
methods.description: Gets password input from user if needed.

methods.name: credential_has_capability
methods.description: Checks if a credential has a specific capability.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential data from a file.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Writes credential data to a file.

methods.name: credential_write_item
methods.description: Helper to write individual credential fields.

methods.name: run_credential_helper
methods.description: Runs an external credential helper process.

methods.name: credential_do
methods.description: Executes credential helper commands.

methods.name: credential_fill
methods.description: Fills credential with data, possibly invoking helpers.

methods.name: credential_approve
methods.description: Stores credential after successful use.

methods.name: credential_reject
methods.description: Rejects and erases credential data.

methods.name: check_url_component
methods.description: Validates URL components for illegal characters.

methods.name: credential_from_url_1
methods.description: Parses a URL into credential fields, supporting partial URLs.

methods.name: credential_from_url_gently
methods.description: Parses URL with strictness control.

methods.name: credential_from_url
methods.description: Parses URL and populates credential struct, aborting on failure.
